$comment: The skills the agents read (devos/skills/README.md, docs/method/DESIGN_METHOD.md §7, PR-51, PR-55, PR-56, PR-57). layers: the vocabulary below; a fence names its own on a `- Layers:` line. topics: words the runner looks for in a fence (or its `- Topics:` line) to pick a conditional file; `match` is a case-insensitive regular expression. stacks: any, a stack id or a toolchain (devos.config.json stack). modules: when set, the entry applies only to a project that chose or uses one of them (devos/answers.json, an active module, or a module the fence names). reads: each file a role reads, for which layers and when, with its priority: required (every task of those layers; the security gate's files), recommended (every task of those layers) or conditional (only when one clause of `if` holds: all of a clause's keys, any of its values; keys topics, modules, deep). deep is a risk-3 task, a task with a gate, or a deep review. The gates: a task with the backend, api, database or reliability layer, or a deep task, always gets the security layer (the security gate), and a task with the frontend, architecture, backend, api, database or reliability layer always gets the testing layer (the test gate); no fence removes them. notes: a file DEV_OS wrote after the audit (origin devos); it is listed first whenever another file of the entry is selected. trust: runs_code and fetches are false for every vendored skill (the cycle runs no code from a skill and fetches nothing at run time), and reviewed is the date its files were read whole. licence.class: free (a permissive licence; ship its licence and notices), conditions (allowed with conditions beyond notices), approval (needs the author's permission or a separate licence first), unsuitable (redistribution not allowed). delivery: vendored (files here, pinned), external (not shipped; a developer may use it interactively), principles (nothing copied; the ideas are written independently). Each source file records the path it was copied from (from); excluded lists the source files deliberately not copied, with why. guard:skills checks every vendored file's sha256 (LF line endings) and that INDEX.md is generated from this file.
